# FLX-6112: a value does not fit its column when the row is made

**Family:** expression language (the 6000 band)

A computed value has more digits than the column's precision allows, more decimal places than its scale, or lies outside the column's integer range. The row would violate the rule that derives it; FLUX refuses to write it.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-6112
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
